For the 8 non-hh families new clang matches GCC in every case except Norm=0/Round=1 (GCC rejects, clang accepts) - the residual difference documented in the F001 note, pre-existing and unreachable from SDK macros. checks.gcc_hh_caveat: GAP9 GCC rejects EVERY direct call to __builtin_pulp_mulhh{s,u}RN / machh{s,u}RN in my probes (and in the worker's own logs/20-F001.verify.log lines 344-346) with 'invalid argument to built-in function on arg 1, builtin arg mode: SI, actual arg mode: HI' - an unrelated GCC arg-mode quirk, not the Norm/Round check. So the F001 result's statement that 'GAP9 GCC rejects (2,1) for ... mulhhsRN/machhsRN' is literally true but not evidence of the rounding rule for the hh forms. The rule for hh is still supported by GCC's own diagnostic text ('__builtin_pulp_mul{hh,}{s,u}NRr ... Round==2^(Norm-1)') and by the SDK/PMSIS macros (__MULHHSRN(x,y,n) -> __builtin_pulp_mulhhsRN(x,y,n,1<<(n-1))). Minor evidence overstatement; does not change the verdict.
